title: 第十九章 惜才也有私心第二十章 圣子别打了
lines: 这一夜，注定不平凡。
因为林昊而引发的一系列事件，还在持续发酵。
李开先父子绝对是林昊成长路上的第一块绊脚石，已经被踩成齑粉。
李家的覆灭也是必然了。
这个世界上，很多事发生的总是这么突然，李开先昨日还在太玄宗一手遮天，横行无忌，他们攀龙附凤，感受到了无上的锦绣前程。
仅仅一日，便从高处跌入谷底，成为亡魂，连带着李家也遭了殃。
而林昊十丈龙门的冲击力，直接冲到了帝都。
此刻，西门先生的住所内。
一个黑衣人无声无息降临，那是一个老者，看起来和西门先生年龄差不多，修为极高，已经超越了化元境。
“西门先生，好久不见。”
黑衣人站在西门先生面前，笑着打了一个招呼。
“我可不想见你。”
西门先生脸上露出苦笑：“凌耀，我知道你来此的目的，但我有一件事不明白，林昊只不过是一个开脉境的小人物，值得你们凌家如此劳师动众，派你这个天元境高手亲自深夜降临太玄宗。”
“那个小杂种本就不应该存在于世，他打破了龙门纪录，他表现得越优秀，就越必须死。”
凌耀无比淡漠的说道：“西门先生，以你的修为和条件，留在这太玄宗，实在是可惜了，不若加入凌家，我会给你安排一个客卿的头衔，凌家的修行资源也会为你开放，而你只需要……”
“闭上吧。”
凌耀话音未落，西门先生直接挥手打断：“老夫在太玄宗几十年，早就习惯了，凌家门槛太高，老夫高攀不起，你走吧。”
看到西门先生的态度，凌耀的神色也是变得寒冷：“林昊必死。”
“怎么？你还敢在太玄宗出手不成？”
西门先生嗤笑一声：“不是我看不起你，再给你十个胆子，你也不敢。”
凌耀气歇，拳头握得咔咔响。
因为他的确不敢在太玄宗内动手。
他不是顾及自己的身份，也不害怕背负以大欺小的骂名，他也不是害怕西门先生。
如今的太玄宗，日落西山，在整个大夏宗门内排行一百零八位。
但，太玄宗却有一个人是真正惹不起的，即便那个人如今不在宗门内。
莫说是他凌耀，让他们凌族神元境的元老来了，也不敢动太玄宗一花一草。
太玄宗的确面临要被除名的危机，但现在，还没除名。
“冥顽不灵，我看你们太玄宗能护他几时。”
凌耀冷哼一声：“凌族，绝不允许那个杂种活着踏入帝都半步。”
“呵呵，凌族作为大夏第一世族，手段却是如此不堪，一代人自有一代人的争锋，凌族只会以大欺小吗？你族天才，连面对林昊的勇气都没有，还是说，十丈龙门，把他们吓瘫了。”
content_en:
This night is destined to be extraordinary.
The series of events caused by Lin Hao are still continuing to ferment.
Li Kaixian and his son were definitely the first stumbling block on Lin Hao's growth path, and they have been trampled into powder.
The destruction of the Li family is inevitable.
In this world, many things always happen so suddenly. Yesterday, Li Kaixian was still in Taixuanzong, covering the sky with one hand and running rampant. They climbed up to the dragon and followed the phoenix, feeling that they had a bright future.
In just one day, he fell from the heights to the bottom and became a dead soul. The Li family also suffered disaster.
And the impact of Lin Hao's ten-foot dragon gate rushed directly to the imperial capital.
At this moment, inside Mr. Ximen’s residence.
A man in black arrived silently. He was an old man. He seemed to be about the same age as Mr. Ximen. He had a very high level of cultivation and had surpassed the Huayuan realm.
"Mr. Ximen, long time no see."
The man in black stood in front of Mr. Ximen and said hello with a smile.
"I don't want to see you."
A bitter smile appeared on Mr. Ximen's face: "Ling Yao, I know the purpose of your coming here, but there is one thing I don't understand. Lin Hao is just a small person in the Pulse Opening Realm. It is worthy of your Ling family's efforts and efforts to send you, a master of the Tianyuan Realm, to personally come to Taixuan Sect late at night."
"That little bastard shouldn't have existed in the world. He broke the Dragon Gate record. The better he performed, the more he had to die."
Ling Yao said indifferently: "Mr. Ximen, with your cultivation and conditions, it is really a pity to stay in Taixuan Sect. If you don't join the Ling family, I will arrange a title of guest minister for you, and the Ling family's cultivation resources will be opened to you, and you only need to..."
"Close it."
Before Ling Yao finished speaking, Mr. Ximen waved his hand and interrupted: "I have been accustomed to it for decades in Taixuan Sect. The threshold of the Ling family is too high for me to reach. You can leave."
Seeing Mr. Ximen's attitude, Ling Yao's expression also turned cold: "Lin Hao must die."
"What? Do you still dare to take action against Taixuan Sect?"
Mr. Ximen sneered: "It's not that I look down on you. If I give you ten more courages, you wouldn't dare."
"You..."
Ling Yao stopped breathing and clenched his fists loudly.
Because he really didn't dare to take action in Taixuan Sect.
He is not concerned about his identity, nor is he afraid of being accused of bullying, nor is he afraid of Mr. Simon.
Today's Taixuan Sect, Sunset Xishan, ranks 108th among the entire Daxia sect.
However, there is one person in Taixuanzong who really cannot be offended, even if that person is not in the sect now.
Not to mention it was him, Ling Yao, who made them, the elders of the Ling Clan's Divine Origin Realm, dare not touch any flower or grass of Taixuan Sect.
Taixuanzong is indeed facing the crisis of being expelled, but now, it has not been expelled.
"He is stubborn, let's see how long your Taixuan Sect can protect him."
Ling Yao snorted coldly: "The Ling clan will never allow that bastard to enter the imperial capital alive."
"Haha, the Ling clan is the first clan in Great Xia, but its methods are so unbearable. Each generation has its own rivalry. Will the Ling clan only use the big to bully the small? The geniuses of your clan don't even have the courage to face Lin Hao. Or is it that the ten-foot-long dragon gate scared them to paralysis?"
title_en: Chapter 19: Cherishing talent also has selfish motives Chapter 20: Stop fighting, Holy Son
